description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different resource types—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—as the number of tokens increases. The x-axis is labeled 'Number of Tokens' and uses a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 200 units. The y-axis represents performance on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units, though specific units are not indicated. The blue line, representing 'Tutorials', begins at approximately 23 when x = 200 and increases steadily to around 35 at x = 800. The red line for 'Library Documentation' starts at about 28 when x = 200, peaks at approximately 35 at x = 500, and then declines sharply to around 25 at x = 800. The yellow line for 'StackOverflow posts' begins at a height of 32 and decreases steadily to about 15 by x = 1000. The green line for 'Github files' starts at 29 and rises smoothly to around 33 at x = 800, then stabilizes at approximately 33 by x = 1000. The yellow line and green line intersect at an x value of approximately 600. A legend at the top of the plot identifies each line by its color and marker style.
